Final excess of ₹153.05
lakh is overstated by
₹154.71 lakh due to
clearance of OB suspense
related to previous years.
Therefore, it is actual
saving of ₹1.66 lakh.
Reasons for surrender of
₹3,274.28 lakh as well as
actual saving have not
been intimated (July
2024).

Reduction in provision of
₹18,530.45 lakh was the net
effect of increase of
₹422.00 lakh and decrease
by re-appropriation of
₹422.00 lakh and surrender
of ₹18,530.45 lakh.
Increase was attributed to
need of additional amounts
in wages, Medical
reimbursement, office
expenses, rent paid and tax
and
Commercial/Arts/Technical
services items. Reduction in
provision by re-
appropriation was attributed
to anticipated saving. Final
excess of ₹65.29 lakh is
overstated by ₹72.22 lakh
due to clearance of OB
suspense related to previous
years. Therefore, it is actual
saving of ₹6.93 lakh.
Reasons for surrender as
well as actual saving have
not been intimated (July
2024).
